note: Generated from the design helper's list (design/work/make_dials.py). Builders may add finer dials with dials.register_layer().

common.name: amount
common.doc: Master dial of the layer. 0 = the surface is exactly as it was before the layer. 1 = normal. 2 = double.

common.name: seed
common.doc: Moves where things fall; the same seed gives the same picture every time. (The kit also gives every object its own seed.)

common.name: inflate_limit
common.doc: A mark may be drawn at most this many times wider than real so that it stays visible at distance; beyond that it fades into an average tone.

common.name: fade_start
common.doc: Metres from the camera where fine detail starts to give way to the average tone.

common.name: fade_end
common.doc: Metres from the camera where fine detail has fully given way to the average tone (never to "clean").

common.name: wet_follow
common.doc: How much the layer follows the Wet Mask where a wetness layer exists (darker and glossier when wet). 0 = ignores wetness.

soot.masks: sheltered, drip, reveal, shade, tx_cavity, height

dials.name: film_mult
dials.doc: Colour multiplier of the general film on the clean surface (brick 0.50 to 0.65 in 1926).

dials.name: sheltered_mult
dials.doc: Multiplier where rain cannot reach (under sills, eaves, in reveals).

dials.name: washed_mult
dials.doc: Multiplier where rain washes (sill tops, the windward upper wall).

dials.name: washed_share
dials.doc: Share of wall area that is rain-washed (15 to 25 % in 1926).

dials.name: floor_mult
dials.doc: No dot may go below this multiple of its clean colour (keeps the film curve from crushing it).

dials.name: grey_pull
dials.doc: How far colour is pulled toward grey (25 to 35 % in 1926).

dials.name: mortar_soot
dials.doc: Extra darkening in mortar hollows (soot sits in hollows first).

dials.name: mottle_size
dials.doc: Size of the slow mottling.

dials.name: mottle_contrast
dials.doc: How strong the mottling is.

dials.name: edge_sharp
dials.doc: How crisp the line is between washed and sheltered (a clean line under a sill).

dials.name: stack_mult
dials.doc: Multiplier on chimney stacks (blackest in a coal town).

dials.name: roof_mult
dials.doc: Multiplier on roof surfaces.

dials.name: base_lift
dials.doc: LAST-RESORT dial: lifts the whole wall colour so that a pattern has room above the film-black zone. Off unless the integrator proves it is needed and says so.

runoff.roles: wall.masonry, wall.trim (iron-sourced streaks use iron objects as sources)

dials.name: strength
dials.doc: Contrast of the streaks.

dials.name: tone
dials.doc: -1 = pale washed stripe, +1 = dark stain. 1926 sooty walls: pale stripes with dark tide-lines. Courtyard plaster: dark grey-green streaks.

dials.name: edge_dark
dials.doc: Dark tide-line along the streak edges.

dials.name: width_dots
dials.doc: Smallest streak width in plate dots (the layer widens a streak with distance up to Inflate Limit).

dials.name: length_mult
dials.doc: Length of every streak.

dials.name: ragged
dials.doc: Ragged sides and a stretched-down shape.

dials.name: source_share
dials.doc: Share of sills, ledges and cap edges that carry a streak pair (60 to 80 % in 1926).

dials.name: leak_share
dials.doc: Share of downpipes that leak heavily and carry a long streak.

dials.name: leak_length
dials.doc: Length of a heavy leak streak.

dials.name: iron_rust
dials.doc: How orange (rust) a streak is when its source is an iron joint or bracket.

dials.name: eave_streaks
dials.doc: Streaks hanging from eave lines, gutter ends and cap overhangs.

foot.masks: height, dampness, drip (pipe feet), tx_cavity, shade

dials.name: splash_height
dials.doc: Height of the dirt splash band at the wall foot (15 to 35 cm in 1926).

dials.name: splash_strength
dials.doc: How dark the band is at the ground line.

dials.name: splash_ragged
dials.doc: Ragged top edge of splash dots and short upward fingers.

dials.name: finger_height
dials.doc: Height of the splash fingers above the band.

dials.name: pipe_foot_boost
dials.doc: Extra heavy splash and damp where a downpipe ends.

dials.name: tide_share
dials.doc: Share of house lengths that carry a damp tide-mark (older rows only).

dials.name: tide_height
dials.doc: Ragged top of the damp tide-mark.

dials.name: tide_strength
dials.doc: Darkening inside the tide-mark.

dials.name: tide_green
dials.doc: How green the damp zone is.

dials.name: salt_bloom
dials.doc: Share of the band covered by white salts along its top.

dials.name: mortar_wear
dials.doc: Recessed, eroded mortar in the lowest 0.6 m.

dials.name: spall_share
dials.doc: Share of bricks or blocks with a flaked face near the foot.

dials.name: wear_height
dials.doc: How high mortar wear and spalls reach.

steps.roles: wall.trim (the steps are found by the step masks, not by object)

dials.name: whitened_share
dials.doc: Share of doorsteps that are whitened or donkey-stoned (40 to 70 %; medium confidence for Durham).

dials.name: scrubbed_share
dials.doc: Share that are only scrubbed pale.

dials.name: frame_m
dials.doc: Real width of the white frame along nosing and riser (4 to 10 cm).

dials.name: frame_dots
dials.doc: Smallest frame width in plate dots (widened with distance up to Inflate Limit).

dials.name: boot_grey
dials.doc: Boots grey the centre of the tread (30 %).

dials.name: dish_depth
dials.doc: Depth of the worn dish in the tread (relief, faded with distance).

dials.name: nosing_chips
dials.doc: Share of steps with a chipped nosing or corner.

dials.name: wear_polish
dials.doc: Polish of the worn centre.

wallgrowth.roles: wall.masonry, wall.trim, wall.plaster, roof.tile (painted moss, algae, lichen)
wallgrowth.masks: moss_site, algae_site, dampness, drip, lichen_site, height

dials.name: moss_amount
dials.doc: Painted moss at wall feet, drips, copings.

dials.name: algae_amount
dials.doc: Green-black algae film at pipe outlets and shaded feet.

dials.name: lichen_amount
dials.doc: Lichen. 1926 coal town: NONE (the smoke killed it). Courtyard: sparse colonies.

dials.name: moss_height
dials.doc: How high up a wall moss may reach from the foot.

dials.name: patch_dots
dials.doc: Smallest moss patch width in plate dots (patches of 15 dots or more survive the painter).

dials.name: drip_moss
dials.doc: Moss below run-off lines.

dials.name: cap_moss
dials.doc: Moss along copings and wall caps.

dials.name: roof_moss
dials.doc: Moss on roof surfaces (probably very little in 1926).

dials.name: tone_steps
dials.doc: Number of flat painted tones in a moss patch.

dials.name: clump_stretch
dials.doc: How much taller than wide a clump is (drip shape).

dials.name: relief
dials.doc: Height of moss relief (a bump on the incoming normal, faded with distance).

dials.name: lichen_dots
dials.doc: Lichen disc size in plate dots.

dials.name: brightness_floor
dials.doc: Lowest plate brightness of a moss patch (it must stay lighter than the stone and above the film-black zone).

wallcracks.masks: corner, reveal, height, tx_cavity, house flag

dials.name: crack_amount
dials.doc: How many cracks (the master Amount scales it too).

dials.name: crack_dots
dials.doc: Smallest crack width in plate dots (3 dots needs contrast 0.11).

dials.name: crack_contrast
dials.doc: Smallest crack contrast against the surround.

dials.name: stepped_cracks
dials.doc: Stepped mining cracks on the houses the set file flags (1 or 2 of 28).

dials.name: corner_chips
dials.doc: Chips at wall corners and opening corners.

dials.name: chip_cm
dials.doc: Chip size in centimetres (chips of about 5 cm and bigger read).

dials.name: plaster_cracks
dials.doc: Map cracks and corner cracks in plaster.

dials.name: spall_patches
dials.doc: Spalled patches near the foot.

dials.name: near_only
dials.doc: Cracks fade out beyond this distance (the painter invents its own texture there).

dials.name: slope_mm
dials.doc: Real slope of a crack edge so a lamp lights one side.

dials.name: dull
dials.doc: Cracks are dull: roughness back to 0.9, shine cut 35 %, water film cut 45 %.

dials.name: paint_dark
dials.doc: General darkening of paint (0.70 to 0.85 in 1926).

dials.name: flake_share
dials.doc: Share of painted area that has lost flakes.

dials.name: door_scuff
dials.doc: Height of kicked scuffs at the foot of doors (bare grey wood).

dials.name: latch_grease
dials.doc: Dark hand-grease patch at the latch.

dials.name: gloss_loss
dials.doc: How much the paint has lost its gloss.

dirt.roles: ground.sett, ground.flag, ground.channel, ground.kerb (gravel and earth in other sets)
dirt.masks: footfall, keepclear, lowness, crown, wall_dist, shade, vertical_foot, prop_dist, seam_dist, entry_rand, step_foot

dials.name: film
dials.doc: Broad soft film of soot and dust, 0.5 to 3 m patches. NOT ash or coal dust (the rubbish layer has those).

dials.name: film_scale
dials.doc: Patch size of the film.

dials.name: film_darkness
dials.doc: Darkening of the film (at most about one third).

dials.name: film_max_share
dials.doc: Ceiling on the share of a surface the film may darken by a third or more.

dials.name: film_near_walls
dials.doc: Keeps the film off the places the rubbish layer already dirties (wall foot, gutter strip). 1 = film everywhere; 0.5 = half strength there.

dials.name: polish
dials.doc: Traffic polish: worn lanes are lighter and smoother.

dials.name: polish_lift
dials.doc: Brightness added to polished lanes.

dials.name: polish_rough
dials.doc: Roughness taken off polished lanes when dry.

dials.name: water_marks
dials.doc: Dried puddle rings and tide lines in low spots.

dials.name: rust_halo
dials.doc: Rust stain on the ground round the foot of iron posts and pipes (10 to 25 cm).

dials.name: rust_halo_m
dials.doc: Reach of the rust halo.

dials.name: drum_ring
dials.doc: Rust bleed ring on the ground at the foot of the fire drum (the ash ring is already in the rubbish layer).

dials.name: tar_patches
dials.doc: Tar patches over lost setts: scalloped edges, speckle of chippings.

dials.name: tar_max_share
dials.doc: Ceiling on tar patches as a share of road area (2 to 4 %).

dials.name: tar_splash
dials.doc: Splashes of tar at the kerb foot.

dials.name: tar_gloss
dials.doc: How glossy new tar is (near black when wet).

dials.name: scrub_strip
dials.doc: Pale scrubbed strip on the flags in front of a whitened or scrubbed doorstep (reads the same door random as the steps layer).

dials.name: scrub_strip_m
dials.doc: Reach of the scrubbed strip.

groundcracks.masks: edge_dist, seam_dist, cover_dist, footfall, tx_cell (flags, setts), tx_cavity, crown

dials.name: flag_cracks
dials.doc: Amount of flag cracking.

dials.name: flag_fine_share
dials.doc: Share of flags with a fine crack (8 to 15 %).

dials.name: flag_broken_share
dials.doc: Share broken in two or three with a gap (2 to 4 %).

dials.name: flag_tilt_share
dials.doc: Share tilted or sunk (3 to 6 %).

dials.name: tilt_lip
dials.doc: Height of the raised edge of a tilted flag (throws a dark shadow line).

dials.name: corner_chip_share
dials.doc: Share of flags with a chipped corner.

dials.name: kerb_chips
dials.doc: Amount of kerb damage.

dials.name: kerb_chip_share
dials.doc: Share of kerb length with edge chips (20 to 35 %).

dials.name: kerb_break_share
dials.doc: Share of kerb stones cracked or broken (1 in 15).

dials.name: kerb_scuffs
dials.doc: Pale wheel scuffs on kerb faces.

dials.name: kerb_joint_open
dials.doc: Width of open, dark kerb joints.

dials.name: sett_disturb
dials.doc: Amount of disturbed setts (tilted, sunk, missing, ash or tar filled).

dials.name: sett_disturbed_share
dials.doc: Share of the sett field disturbed (3 to 6 %), gathered round seams, covers and wheel bands.

dials.name: open_joint_share
dials.doc: Share of sett joints open and dark (10 to 20 %).

dials.name: missing_share
dials.doc: Share of setts missing (dark rectangle).

dials.name: sunken_patch
dials.doc: Length of a sunken patch.

dials.name: crack_dots
dials.doc: Smallest crack width in plate dots.

dials.name: crack_contrast
dials.doc: Smallest crack contrast.

dials.name: near_only
dials.doc: Cracks fade out beyond this distance.

dials.name: max_contrast
dials.doc: Guard: no harsh black grid. Sett joints may not exceed this contrast.

dials.name: dull
dials.doc: Cracks are dull so the wet look cannot wash them out.

groundmoss.roles: ground.sett, ground.flag, ground.channel, ground.kerb (ground.earth, stone.natural in other sets)
groundmoss.masks: moss_site, algae_site, tx_cavity, tx_joint, shade, dampness, footfall, keepclear, existing_growth

dials.name: joint_share
dials.doc: Share of joint length carrying painted moss in the best (gutter-side) strip.

dials.name: shade_bias
dials.doc: How much shade favours moss over sun.

dials.name: ribbon_dots
dials.doc: Smallest moss ribbon width in plate dots (a 1 to 3 cm joint ribbon is drawn wider near the camera).

dials.name: ribbon_m
dials.doc: Real ribbon width.

dials.name: broken_len
dials.doc: Length of a broken ribbon piece.

dials.name: algae_fan
dials.doc: Dark green-black algae fan under every downpipe outlet and gully.

dials.name: algae_radius
dials.doc: Reach of an algae fan.

dials.name: liverwort
dials.doc: The one bright green: 0 to 2 patches of 10 to 40 cm in damp shade.

dials.name: far_band
dials.doc: Beyond the pieces distance: a slightly greener, darker strip along gutter and wall foot instead of single plants.

dials.name: far_band_m
dials.doc: Width of the far band.

dials.name: moss_value
dials.doc: Plate brightness of dry moss (lighter than the stone; painted values under 0.12 are black on the film).

iron.roles: iron, iron.post, iron.pipe, fire (cast iron, steel, drum, rails)
iron.masks: height, object zmin and zmax, drip_kind, vertical_foot

dials.name: rust_cover
dials.doc: Share of the lower part of an iron object with paint chipped back to rust.

dials.name: rust_height
dials.doc: How high rust reaches from the foot of a post.

dials.name: chip_share
dials.doc: Share of paint chipped in the rust zone.

dials.name: collar_spacing
dials.doc: Spacing of pipe collars and joints where rust rings sit.

dials.name: collar_rust
dials.doc: Share of collars with rust.

dials.name: metallic_drop
dials.doc: Rust lowers Metallic by up to this fraction (cast iron 0.6, steel 0.5, brass 0.9).

dials.name: heat_scale
dials.doc: Heat-blued scale on the fire drum only.

dials.name: soot_halo
dials.doc: Sooty halo above the drum vent holes and black rim.

dials.name: paint_keep
dials.doc: Share of the original paint kept (black or dark green).

dials.name: rust_run
dials.doc: Length of rust runs below fixings.

growth.roles: ground.sett, ground.flag, ground.channel, ground.kerb (scatter targets; others by settings)
growth.masks: weed_site, moss_site, keepclear, footfall, rubbish_heap, wall_dist, seam_dist, shade, dampness, existing_growth

dials.name: weeds_amount
dials.doc: Amount of weed pieces (grass tufts, rosettes). 0 = none.

dials.name: cushions_amount
dials.doc: Amount of moss cushion pieces. 0 = none.

dials.name: distance
dials.doc: Pieces are laid only up to this far from the camera (the camera of the picture being drawn).

dials.name: distance_fade
dials.doc: Length of the fade-out at the pieces distance.

dials.name: piece_size
dials.doc: Size of every piece (1 = as built to the period sizes).

dials.name: weed_cover
dials.doc: Green cover of weeds as a share of ground area inside the pieces distance (0.5 to 2 % in 1926).

dials.name: gutter_tuft_share
dials.doc: Share of gutter-side joint length with a visible tuft (3 to 8 %).

dials.name: wall_foot_share
dials.doc: Share of wall-foot length with a plant (2 to 5 %).

dials.name: cushion_cover
dials.doc: Moss cushion cover as a share of ground area inside the pieces distance.

dials.name: min_spacing
dials.doc: Nearest two pieces of one kind may be.

dials.name: toadflax_clumps
dials.doc: Ivy-leaved toadflax trails on damp mortar: 0 to 2 clumps in the whole street.

dials.name: rubbish_thin_max
dials.doc: Weeds grow at full density through rubbish thinner than this mask value.

dials.name: rubbish_heap_min
dials.doc: No weeds (and no moss above 0.6) on rubbish heavier than this mask value; between the two it thins out linearly.

dials.name: dead_grass_share
dials.doc: Share of grass tufts that are dead and straw-coloured.

dials.name: flower_share
dials.doc: Share of dandelions in flower or seed-clock (a few only).

dials.name: max_pieces
dials.doc: Hard ceiling on pieces in one picture (drawing time).

dials.name: wet_dark
dials.doc: Colour multiple of wet pieces (richer green, darker).

dials.name: tilt_random
dials.doc: How much each piece leans.
